prose: Pluto Security, which monitors AI agents and vibe-coded apps, exits stealth with $42M including a $34M Series A. The pitch: when everyone in a company has AI tools, they use them in unexpected ways, seeding fears of new security holes (TechCrunch).
highlights: Pluto Security exits stealth with $42M ($34M Series A).
Monitors AI agents and vibe-coded apps.
Targets risks from broad enterprise AI-tool adoption.
